turns.text: Here is the engineering behind what you just saw. Stay streams raw twenty-four kilohertz PCM audio over a single full-duplex WebSocket to AssemblyAI's Universal-Three Pro Voice Agent API—delivering sub-second turn-taking, live barge-in, ADHD keyterm boosting, and thirty-two language detection without stitching separate pipelines.
